system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you make an attack, if you have at least one Bunshin active, you can spend one superiority die to have the Bunshin attack with you by throwing themselves at the enemy. Dismiss any number of Bunshin you have active. For every clone dismissed this way, you reduce the targets AC by -1 (Max -3) and their DR by 2 (Max of -6) for the triggering attack and its subsequent damage roll.
